title: Machine learning forecasts ventilator-associated pneumonia up to a week ahead
summary: Supervised models on ICU electronic health record data (507 patients, 261 with VAP) reached an AUROC of 0.866 and, in external MIMIC-IV data, 0.817 within five days. Performance did not generalize to the AMIKINHAL cohort when feature overlap was poor. This is a retrospective preprint.
ai_technology: Supervised machine learning models on routinely collected ICU data
organization: Department of Computer Science, Northwestern University, Chicago, USA; Division of Pulmonary and Critical Care, Northwestern University Feinberg School of Medicine, Chicago, USA

evidence.tested: External validation in MIMIC-IV and AMIKINHAL.
evidence.unknown: Real-time prospective performance; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Models forecast VAP onset from EHR variables.
